title: Anthropic says it believes the US government's export control order for Mythos 5 and Fable 5 is a "misunderstanding" and that it is working to restore access (Ananya Palyekar/Reuters)
summary: Ananya Palyekar / Reuters: Anthropic says it believes the US government's export control order for Mythos 5 and Fable 5 is a “misunderstanding” and that it is working to restore access — Anthropic said on Friday it has been ordered by the U.S. government to suspend access for all foreign nationals …
